description: This file defines a class VectorStoreToDocument_DocumentLoaders implementing the INode interface, which facilitates searching documents from a vector store with scoring and query options. It includes methods for initializing the node, performing similarity search, and returning either document objects or concatenated text.

classes.name: VectorStoreToDocument_DocumentLoaders
